item.title: Consumer rights in the UK have shifted quietly, and most people haven’t noticed. The big change is that the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act is now fully in force. That means fake reviews are illegal, and subscription traps are finally being cracked down on. If a company auto-renews your contract without a clear reminder, they’re breaking the law. You can also cancel most subscriptions with a few clicks, not a phone call to a call centre that puts you on hold for an hour.
